summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and spot prices weakened broadly today. DCE most-traded closed at 648.0 yuan/mt, down 3.21%from the previous close. All eight Qingdao spot products declined, seaborne 61% and 65% indices fell to USD 88.70 and 104.20/dmt, and all 12 brands moved lower.
